title: I'm Already the Most Dramatic
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished16:9 landscape illustrated YouTube thumbnail, an ALTERNATE ORIGINAL CONCEPT for Nemi's comic promise to become the biggest storytime animator.
INPUT ROLES: Image1 Raora collage = typography weight/bright backgrounds/cutout hierarchy only; image2 approved EP10 = illustrated promotional finish only; image3 actual Nemi episode = canonical identity. No teacher, costumes or characters borrowed from1 or2. Nemi has long red-orange straight hair with small ahoge and jagged bangs, emerald-green eyes, sage-green high-neck drawstring outfit, dark crossbody strap, pale skin, rounded face construction and warm burgundy line art.
IDEA: literal comic giant, not the same book-presentation layout. A colossal Nemi leans over a miniature city made of upright blank storyboard panels, as if storytime animation were her tiny tabletop kingdom. Her enormous pleased face fills the middle-right, chin raised, half-lidded green eyes, smug mischievous smile. One enormous hand rests naturally on the top edge of a tall spiral sketchbook tower at left, fingers cleanly curling around the edge. At the bottom-left, three tiny anonymous simple doodle animator silhouettes look up in comically astonished poses. They are symbolic imaginary competitors, not recognizable real creators. The giant/tiny scale is playful visual metaphor for her line about becoming the biggest; no violence, smashed buildings or injury.
COMPOSITION: bold extremely simple forms; the huge face remains readable at160x90. Only two or three large storyboard towers with legible comic-panel shapes, no tiny written details. Bright white/pale mint checker background, clean white cutout edges with selective red contour, sparse red comic scale rays. The main face/hand/storyboard tower forms one clear visual triangle. Avoid lots of small accents. Leave bottom-right clear for platform duration.
TEXT EXACTLY: "BIGGEST? EASY." Only this one headline, across the upper quarter, broad heavy WHITE sans with very thick BLACK inner / RED middle / BLACK outer outline layers matching reference2. Safe margins; no eye obstruction. No other text, labels, captions, metrics, watermark, screenshot UI or badge. Opaque16:9 high-impact illustrated thumbnail. Preserve her recognizable simple storytime identity rather than an anime makeover.
